a.lede: A new Texas-based defense startup has a plan to improve military and police dogs in the US: it's going to genetically modify them and equip them with Anduril's military technology. Warhound is the brainchild of Anduril's Palmer Luckey and Ben Lamm, co-founder of Colossal Biosciences (the company that says it's trying to resurrect extinct animals), […]
a.title: Startup equips genetically enhanced dogs with Palmer Luckey’s military tech

b.lede: Warhound is genetically engineering dogs for the military, law enforcement and first responder operations.
b.title: A startup called Warhound is genetically engineering dogs for the military
